sharing.title: Access security
sharing.description: Public access, share links, and presigned URLs. A lower level can only make these rules stricter.
sharing.loadError: Could not load the sharing policy.
sharing.publicAccessHint: Anonymous downloads and public-read buckets stop working. Existing flags stay, but files are not served.
sharing.shareLinksHint: People with a link can download a file. Turning this off blocks existing links until you turn it back on.
sharing.presignHint: A signed URL lets someone upload or download without logging in, until it expires.
sharing.passwordRequired: Require a password on share links
sharing.passwordHint: A new link cannot be created without a password.
sharing.ttlHint: Leave days and hours empty to inherit. “No limit” removes the share cap only when an administrator above has not set one. Default is 7 days.
sharing.presignTtlHint: Cannot be longer than 7 days. Leave the fields empty to inherit.
sharing.disableBody: Existing links will stop working while sharing is off. To delete them, use “Revoke all links”.
sharing.effective: Effective now: public access {{publicAccess}}, share links {{links}}, maximum lifetime {{ttl}}.
sharing.operatorBanner: Legacy operator write mode is enabled (STORAGE_OPERATOR_WRITE_ALL). It will be removed in 1.7.0.

mfaPolicy.title: Bucket-admin 2FA
mfaPolicy.description: Require a second factor for bucket administrators and confirm each dangerous action. The change applies on the next request.
mfaPolicy.requireBucketAdminHint: Owners and users with admin grant on at least one bucket. After the grace period, dangerous actions return 403 until they enroll.
mfaPolicy.graceHint: 0 to 90. A missing value is 7 days. During grace the banner is shown and actions stay allowed until a local factor exists.
mfaPolicy.tenantAdminsHint: Tenant administrators follow the same rule even without a bucket-admin grant.
mfaPolicy.globalAdminsHint: Same switch as “Require MFA for administrators” in system settings. Global administrators must enroll before using the console. A global administrator who owns a bucket or holds an admin grant is still covered when this switch is off, and cannot reset someone else's 2FA without their own.
mfaPolicy.actionsTitle: Actions that need a fresh code
mfaPolicy.actionsHint: Each action asks for a code again. There is no time window.
mfaPolicy.missingEmpty: Everyone covered by the policy has a factor.
